package.name: locrec
package.description: Localizability-aware LiDAR odometry: scan-to-map registration with a Hessian-based degeneracy detector, a landmark (marker) estimator, and the scheduling policies that decide when to mount a marker or where to look. Pure Python with no ROS dependency, so the same code runs inside the locrec_ros nodes and in the offline experiments. Also installs the calibrated thresholds the nodes read.
